 SHEIN recalls Glow-In-The-Dark Ocean Animal Bath Toy set
 Notice details Publication date: 10 November 2026
 SHEIN is carrying out a recall of a Glow-In-The-Dark Ocean Animal Bath Toy set sold on the SHEIN marketplace by the third-party seller Shantou Enchengbao Toys Co. Ltd.
 The product presents a risk of choking. The turtle toy included in the product contains a protruding part. A small child could put the small part in their mouth and choke.
 The product reference number is sl25050994064617056. The batch number is 521.
 There are approximately 26 affected products in the Republic of Ireland. 
 This product may have also been sold on AliExpress.
 What to do:
 If you purchased one of these products, please stop use immediately, discard the product, and keep it out of the reach of children.
 If you wish to contact SHEIN for a refund or have any concerns or questions about this product this can be done by contacting SHEIN customer services by email at eurcsteam@shein.com .
